items: The regional director signed the amended lease ____ after the legal department completed its review.
The emphatic pronoun 'himself' stresses that the regional director personally signed the lease.
Ms. Chen reminded ____ to attach the updated price list before sending the proposal.
Ms. Chen is both the person giving the reminder and the person receiving it, so 'herself' is required.
The automatic gate resets ____ after remaining open for more than two minutes.
The gate performs the resetting action on itself, so 'itself' is required.
The consultants introduced ____ to the client before beginning the workshop.
The consultants are both the people introducing and the people being introduced, so 'themselves' is required.
I ____ reviewed every expense entry before submitting the reimbursement report.
The emphatic pronoun 'myself' stresses that the speaker personally reviewed every entry.
The interns organized ____ into three teams for the inventory count.
The interns perform the organizing action on themselves, so 'themselves' is required.
You can familiarize ____ with the new expense policy by reading the examples on the intranet.
The fixed pattern 'familiarize yourself with' requires the reflexive pronoun when the subject and object are the same person.
The laboratory technicians calibrated the backup sensor ____ rather than sending it to an outside vendor.
'Themselves' emphasizes that the technicians personally calibrated the sensor.
The chief financial officer ____ presented the revised forecast to the board.
The emphatic pronoun 'herself' stresses that the chief financial officer personally presented the forecast.
Mr. Patel prepared ____ for the negotiation by reviewing the supplier's previous contracts.
Mr. Patel is both the person preparing and the person being prepared, so 'himself' is required.
The application automatically updates ____ whenever a new security patch is installed.
The application acts on itself, so the reflexive pronoun 'itself' is required.
We completed the annual equipment audit ____ without hiring temporary staff.
'Ourselves' emphasizes that we completed the audit without outside assistance.
The branch manager ____ called the customer to apologize for the billing error.
The emphatic pronoun 'himself' stresses that the branch manager personally made the call.
The new employees helped ____ to refreshments during the orientation break.
The fixed expression 'help themselves to' requires the reflexive pronoun because the employees serve themselves.
She found ____ leading the client presentation when the project manager was delayed.
In the pattern 'find oneself doing something', the subject and object refer to the same person, so 'herself' is required.
The two departments resolved the scheduling conflict ____ before it affected the launch date.
'Themselves' emphasizes that the departments resolved the conflict without outside intervention.
I promised ____ that I would finish the compliance course before Friday.
The speaker makes the promise to the same person who is the subject, so 'myself' is required.
The design team distinguished ____ from competitors by offering a longer warranty.
The pattern 'distinguish oneself from' requires the reflexive pronoun when the subject differentiates itself from others.
Please seat ____ in the waiting area until a service representative is available.
The imperative addresses the same person who is to be seated, so 'yourself' is required.
The software vendor handled the emergency migration ____ instead of subcontracting the work.
'Itself' emphasizes that the software vendor handled the migration directly.
The owner ____ inspected the renovated storefront before approving the final payment.
The emphatic pronoun 'herself' stresses that the owner personally inspected the storefront.
The trainees challenged ____ to finish the safety drill within the required time.
The trainees are both the people setting the challenge and the people receiving it, so 'themselves' is required.
He made ____ available to answer questions after the quarterly briefing.
The fixed pattern 'make oneself available' requires the reflexive pronoun, so 'himself' is correct.
The committee members kept the preliminary findings to ____ until the audit was complete.
The fixed pattern 'keep something to themselves' requires the reflexive pronoun for information retained within the same group.
We ____ contacted the carrier to confirm that the replacement parts had shipped.
The emphatic pronoun 'ourselves' stresses that we personally contacted the carrier.
